Run by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Shettora]], a '''criminal faction''' operated out of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. The faction sold decent merchandise that was priced only a bit higher than its real value. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the organization dealt with the [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] crew of the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'' in a business agreement.

==History==
The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Shettora]] led a criminal faction by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] that was based out of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. The organization controlled the [[Black market/Legends|black market]] on Brentaal IV and had good-quality merchandise that was marked up only a bit over its real value. [[Puullo]], another Hutt, was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the faction and acted as the "beachhead" of Shettora's operations.<ref name="Orbit" />

{{RPGseed}}
In 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], Puullo and the other Hutts in the organization dealt with the crew of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]''. In exchange for 30 percent of the goods and merchandise seized by the ''Far Orbit'', the Hutts would give the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] to use, illegal weaponry, and protection from the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who might search for the crew of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. However, ''Far Orbit'' [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dhas Fenoep Vedij]] excluded any military hardware he seized from being handed over to the organization as part of the deal.<ref name="Orbit" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The criminal faction was first mentioned in [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and was a sequel of sorts to the previous publication, ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', carrying on that book's theme by following the ''Far Orbit''{{'s}} adventures. It is possible that the Hutts of the organization demand that the crew of the ''Far Orbit'' pass a test or undertake a risky errand before the faction agrees to do business with the privateers.
